en: The image shows a vintage colored postcard depicting a view of a seaside promenade and an ornate building labeled 'Strandcasino' with people walking along the beach. There is a large building in the background, lush greenery, and a lighthouse or lookout tower-like structure. The scene is tranquil and picturesque, typical of early 20th-century European coastal resorts. The style of dress of the people suggests a historical period, likely late 19th to early 20th century.
